description: Maya is holding the key to the family's inherited 22-foot sailboat and must decide whether and how to arrange a family outing, including the launch timing, boarding plan, and a needed repair, with input from her brother Owen, cousin Leah, and aunt Rosa.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Boat Key Holder and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has inherited a 22-foot sailboat, and Maya currently keeps its key and handles plans for taking it onto Lake Mercer.
shared_context.S2: The boat can be launched from either the south ladder dock or the north floating dock, which has a ramp from the parking area.
shared_context.S3: The family is considering one summer outing on the lake, and the boat's regular life jackets and seating are available.
shared_context.S4: Maya will confirm the launch reservation during the family's Sunday dinner.
shared_context.S5: The outing plan will include a launch date, start and end times, boarding arrangements, and any work that must be completed before launch.

PF1.text: Owen's shoulder is recovering from surgery, so he must board as a seated passenger from the north floating dock's ramp and cannot be lifted or asked to climb the south ladder; he has not mentioned this to Maya.

PF2.text: Leah had the boat inspected by marine mechanic Carlos Nguyen, who said the existing pump must be replaced with a 12V marine bilge pump and tested before anyone launches; Leah received the recommendation in the inspection note and has not shared it with the family.

PF3.text: Rosa already promised her visiting grandchildren a boat outing on 2026-07-18 from 10:00 through 14:00, and she has not yet told Maya that this promise fixes the family's outing window.

acceptance_conditions: The outing must be scheduled for 2026-07-18 from 10:00 through 14:00.
Owen must board as a seated passenger from the north floating dock, with no lifting or ladder climbing required.
The existing pump must be replaced before launch with a 12V marine bilge pump.
The replacement pump must be tested before launch.
A commitment to complete and test the pump replacement before launch must be recorded.
Owen's accessibility requirement must be cited in the final justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['outing_date'] == '2026-07-18' or decisions['outing_date'] == 'July 18th, 2026' or decisions['outing_date'] == 'July 18, 2026' or decisions['outing_date'] == 'July 18 2026'
content_checks.C2: decisions['outing_start'] == '10:00' or decisions['outing_start'] == '10:00 AM' or decisions['outing_start'] == '10 AM' or decisions['outing_start'] == '10:00 in the morning'
content_checks.C3: decisions['outing_end'] == '14:00' or decisions['outing_end'] == '2:00 PM' or decisions['outing_end'] == '2 PM' or decisions['outing_end'] == '14:00 PM' or decisions['outing_end'] == '2:00 in the afternoon'
content_checks.C4: decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'north floating dock' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'North floating dock' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'north floating dock with ramp' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'North floating dock with ramp' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'north floating dock ramp' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'North floating dock ramp' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'north floating dock (ramp)' or decisions['boarding_dock'] == 'North floating dock (ramp)'
content_checks.C6: decisions['pump_model'] == '12V marine bilge pump' or decisions['pump_model'] == '12-volt marine bilge pump' or decisions['pump_model'] == '12V bilge pump'

decisive_facts.why: Owen's surgery changes the boarding dock to the north floating dock, changes his role to seated passenger, and changes the plan from possible ladder climbing or lifting to no lifting.
Carlos Nguyen's inspection changes the required pre-launch work from no specified repair to replacing and testing an exact 12V marine bilge pump before launch.
Rosa's existing promise changes the outing from an arbitrary summer date and time to exactly July 18, 2026, from 10:00 AM through 2:00 PM.
